title: Ausschreitungen in der Rigaer Straße – Strafermittlungsverfahren eingeleitet

extraction.summaryEn: Over the weekend of 11 July 2026, groups in Friedrichshain set fires on the street, burned bins and a construction barrier, and attacked police with pyrotechnics and a glass bottle during a rally-related disturbance. No one was injured; four criminal proceedings were opened.
